housePointDisplayContract.rendering: Retain one point-layer entry per valid scoped source record at every supported display zoom. No application-level viewport filtering or display limit; native renderer viewport clipping is permitted.
housePointDisplayContract.coordinateAuthority: Retain exact processed source coordinates; do not jitter, spread, substitute centroids or infer unique households.
housePointDisplayContract.overlapSelection: Map picking opens a source-record choice list for overlapping candidates, with stable record IDs/source rows and house number when present; never silently choose the first record.
housePointDisplayContract.keyboardAlternative: The record list/search provides keyboard access to the same eligible source records; point rendering must not be the only selection path.
housePointDisplayContract.scopeCounts: Boundary intersection remains the aggregate authority; native viewport clipping and visual overlap do not change source/mapped counts or imply coverage.
housePointDisplayContract.acceptance: At low and high zoom there are no cluster/count badges; each point retains source identity and overlapping candidates remain reachable.
